clips.title: The story
paras: Bandits and harvest golems hold Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in northern Westfall, off the road from Elwynn Forest. Farmer Furlbrow and Verna have lost their home to the Defias Brotherhood.

Near Westfall's northern border, Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm once grew crops to feed the kingdom. The Defias Brotherhood drove Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna from their land. Mechanical harvest golems now roam the fields, attacking anyone who approaches. Bandits occupy the farm buildings, while the rightful owners camp beside the road near the Jansen Stead, mourning their lost home and livelihood.

The Defias Brotherhood has claimed homesteads like Furlbrow's as Stormwind's military garrison struggles to protect Westfall's rural farmers. Bandits camp at the farm and use it as a staging ground. Lethal harvest watchers guard the perimeter, leaving travelers on the nearby highway vulnerable to ambush.
